summary.headline: Gemini and Celestial Correspondences
summary.text: Astrological descriptions of an unnamed earthy sign, including its effects on births, geographical correspondences, and associated stars. Gemini is then characterized by gender, voice, fertility, occupations, degree qualities, winds, stars, and neighboring celestial figures including Cetus, Satyr, and Lyre.
